```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  if (isTRUE(params$plot_vbias)) library(ggside)
})
setDTthreads(max(1L, as.integer(params$threads)))

binom_ci_dedup <- function(mod_vec, n_vec, conf = 0.999) {
  pairs <- data.table(mod = mod_vec, n = n_vec)
  unique_pairs <- unique(pairs[n > 0])
  unique_pairs[, `:=`(
    lower_ci = mapply(function(k, n) binom.test(k, n, conf.level = conf)$conf.int[1], mod, n),
    upper_ci = mapply(function(k, n) binom.test(k, n, conf.level = conf)$conf.int[2], mod, n)
  )]
  result <- merge(pairs, unique_pairs, by = c("mod", "n"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  result[is.na(lower_ci), `:=`(lower_ci = 0.0, upper_ci = 0.0)]
  list(lower = result$lower_ci, upper = result$upper_ci)
}

calculate_cutoff <- function(mbias_table) {
  mbias_table <- mbias_table[order(mbias_table$pos),]
  n_obs <- nrow(mbias_table)
  if (n_obs < 3) return(data.frame(left = as.double(0), right = as.double(0)))
  upper_lim    <- min(ceiling(n_obs * 0.8), n_obs-1)
  lower_lim    <- max(floor(n_obs * 0.2), 2)
  mean_middle  <- mean(mbias_table[lower_lim:upper_lim,]$beta)
  upper_ci_max <- max(mbias_table[lower_lim:upper_lim,]$upper_ci)
  lower_ci_min <- min(mbias_table[lower_lim:upper_lim,]$lower_ci)

  check_match <- function(row, mean_middle, lower_ci_min, upper_ci_max) {
    if (is.na(mean_middle) || is.null(mean_middle) || is.na(row$beta) || is.null(row$beta) ||
        is.na(lower_ci_min) || is.null(lower_ci_min) || is.na(upper_ci_max) || is.null(upper_ci_max)) {
      return(FALSE)
    }
    !row$beta %between% c(lower_ci_min, upper_ci_max) &&
      abs(row$beta - mean_middle) > 0.05 &&
      !mean_middle %between% c(row$lower_ci, row$upper_ci)
  }

  left_cutoff <- 0; right_cutoff <- 0
  middle <- ceiling(n_obs/2)
  for (pos in middle:1) {
    if (check_match(mbias_table[pos,], mean_middle, lower_ci_min, upper_ci_max)) { left_cutoff <- pos; break }
  }
  for (pos in 1:(n_obs-middle)) {
    if (check_match(mbias_table[middle+pos,], mean_middle, lower_ci_min, upper_ci_max)) {
      right_cutoff <- n_obs - (middle+pos) + 1; break
    }
  }
  data.frame(left=as.double(left_cutoff), right=as.double(right_cutoff))
}
```

```{r load_rds, include=FALSE}
.ts <- function(msg) cat(format(Sys.time(), "[%H:%M:%S]"), " [gather] ", msg, "\n", file=stderr(), sep="")

if (is.null(params$rds_dir) || !dir.exists(params$rds_dir)) {
  stop("params$rds_dir must point to a directory containing chrN_mbias_table.rds files")
}

rds_files <- sort(list.files(params$rds_dir, pattern="_mbias_table\\.rds$", full.names=TRUE))
if (length(rds_files) == 0) stop("No *_mbias_table.rds files found in: ", params$rds_dir)
.ts(paste0("loading ", length(rds_files), " RDS files from ", params$rds_dir))

.chunks  <- lapply(rds_files, readRDS)
read_len <- max(sapply(.chunks, `[[`, "read_len"))  # take global max across chromosomes
.ts(paste0("read_len=", read_len))

mbias_table <- rbindlist(lapply(.chunks, `[[`, "mbias_table"))

# Collect per-chr vdata tiles when V-bias was computed in stage 1
if (isTRUE(params$plot_vbias)) {
  .vdata_list <- lapply(.chunks, `[[`, "vdata")
  .vdata_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), .vdata_list)
  if (length(.vdata_list) > 0) {
    vdata <- rbindlist(.vdata_list)
    .ts(paste0("vdata combined: ", nrow(vdata), " tiles"))
  } else {
    vdata <- NULL
    warning("plot_vbias=TRUE but no vdata found in RDS files — were chr jobs run with --vbias?")
  }
  rm(.vdata_list)
}

rm(.chunks); gc()
.ts(paste0("combined: ", nrow(mbias_table), " rows, ", length(unique(mbias_table$chr)), " chromosomes"))

mbias_table[, beta := mod / (mod + unmod)]

.ts("computing binom CIs (deduped)...")
.t0 <- proc.time()
ci <- binom_ci_dedup(mbias_table$mod, mbias_table$mod + mbias_table$unmod)
mbias_table[, lower_ci := ci$lower][, upper_ci := ci$upper]
mbias_table <- mbias_table[, .(beta=first(beta), lower_ci=first(lower_ci), upper_ci=first(upper_ci)),
                             by=.(chr, pos, read_pair, strand)]
mbias_table <- mbias_table[!is.na(beta)]
setkey(mbias_table, chr, pos)
.ts(paste0("binom CIs done (", round((proc.time()-.t0)["elapsed"], 1), "s)"))

fwrite(mbias_table[order(chr, as.integer(pos), read_pair, strand)],
       file.path(params$output_dir, "mbias_table.tsv"), sep="\t")
.ts("mbias_table.tsv written")
```

## M-bias plots

```{r plot_mbias, echo=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
.primary_re <- "^(chr)?([0-9]+|[XY])$"
.chroms <- unique(mbias_table$chr)
.chroms <- .chroms[order(suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^chr", "", as.character(.chroms)))),
                         as.character(.chroms), na.last=TRUE)]

for (.i in seq_along(.chroms)) {
  chrom <- .chroms[.i]
  cat(format(Sys.time(), "[%H:%M:%S]"), " [plot_mbias] chromosome ", chrom,
      " (", .i, "/", length(.chroms), ")\n", file=stderr(), sep="")

  cutoffs <- mbias_table[chr==chrom, calculate_cutoff(as.data.frame(.SD)), by=.(chr, read_pair, strand)]

  if (!is.na(params$output_dir) && !is.null(params$output_dir)) {
    out_table <- cutoffs[, .(l_ot = .SD[read_pair=="First",  left],
                             r_ot = .SD[read_pair=="First",  right],
                             l_ob = .SD[read_pair=="Second", left],
                             r_ob = .SD[read_pair=="Second", right]),
                         by=strand]
    setDF(out_table)
    out_table <- out_table[order(out_table$strand, decreasing=TRUE), ]
    write.table(out_table[, 2:5],
                file.path(params$output_dir, paste0(chrom, "_cutoffs.txt")),
                row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=",")
  }

  if (grepl(.primary_re, as.character(chrom))) {
    g <- ggplot(mbias_table[chr==chrom], aes(x=pos, y=beta, color=read_pair)) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lower_ci, ymax=upper_ci, fill=read_pair), alpha=0.2) +
      labs(color="Read") +
      xlab("Position in read (5'->3')") +
      scale_color_discrete(labels=c('First in pair', 'Second in pair')) +
      scale_fill_discrete(guide="none") +
      theme_light()
    if (!is.null(cutoffs)) {
      g <- g + geom_vline(aes(xintercept=left,           color=read_pair), data=cutoffs)
      g <- g + geom_vline(aes(xintercept=read_len-right, color=read_pair), data=cutoffs)
    }
    g <- g + facet_wrap(vars(strand), nrow=2, as.table=FALSE) + ggtitle(chrom)
    print(g)
  }
}
```

## V-bias plots

```{r plot_vbias, echo=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=7, warning=FALSE}
if (isTRUE(params$plot_vbias) && !is.null(vdata) && nrow(vdata) > 0) {
  .vbias_chroms <- unique(vdata$chr)
  .vbias_chroms <- .vbias_chroms[order(suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^chr", "", as.character(.vbias_chroms)))),
                                       as.character(.vbias_chroms), na.last=TRUE)]
  for (chrom in .vbias_chroms) {
    vdata_plot <- vdata[
      chr == chrom,
      .(beta         = sum(n_mod) / sum(n_total),
        observations = sum(n_total)),
      by = .(`Pos in fragment` = pos_in_fragment,
             `Insert size`     = insert_size,
             Orientation)
    ]

    side_counts <- vdata_plot[
      , .(obs = sum(observations)),
      by = .(`Insert size`, Orientation)
    ]
    side_counts[, obs_pdf := obs / sum(obs), by = .(Orientation)]

    y_max <- as.numeric(quantile(vdata_plot[["Insert size"]], 0.99, na.rm=TRUE))
    x_max <- as.numeric(quantile(vdata_plot[["Pos in fragment"]], 0.99, na.rm=TRUE))

    p <- ggplot(vdata_plot, aes(x=`Pos in fragment`, y=`Insert size`, fill=beta)) +
      geom_tile() +
      geom_ysidebar(data=side_counts, aes(y=`Insert size`, x=obs_pdf),
                    inherit.aes=FALSE, stat="identity", orientation="y") +
      ggside(y.pos="left") +
      scale_ysidex_reverse() +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low="black", mid="orange", high="purple", midpoint=0.5) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, 600), expand=c(0, 0)) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0, 600), expand=c(0, 0)) +
      ggtitle(chrom) +
      facet_wrap(vars(Orientation)) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(panel.grid=element_blank(),
            ggside.panel.grid=element_blank(),
            ggside.axis.title.x=element_blank(),
            ggside.axis.text.x=element_blank(),
            ggside.axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
    print(p)
  }
  rm(vdata)
  invisible(gc())
}
```

## CpG/GC bias

```{r parse_gc, include=FALSE}
if (isTRUE(params$plot_gc)) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Rsamtools)
    library(Biostrings)
  })

  if (is.na(params$input_vcf) || is.null(params$input_vcf) || !file.exists(params$input_vcf)) {
    stop("plot_gc=TRUE but input_vcf is missing or does not exist: ", params$input_vcf)
  }
  if (is.na(params$reference) || is.null(params$reference) || !file.exists(params$reference)) {
    stop("plot_gc=TRUE but reference is missing or does not exist: ", params$reference)
  }

  command <- paste(params$bcftools, "norm -m-any", params$input_vcf,
                   "|", params$bcftools,
                   "query -f \"%CHROM\\t%POS\\t%REF\\t%ALT\\t%CPGnovo[\\t%TGT\\t%DP\\t%M5mC]\\n\"")
  all_calls <- fread(cmd=command, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, header=FALSE)
  setnames(all_calls, c("chr", "pos", "ref", "alt", "isDN", "genotype", "depth", "beta"))
  all_calls[grepl(",", beta, fixed=TRUE), beta := tstrsplit(beta, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]]]
  all_calls[, beta := as.numeric(beta)]
  all_calls[, `:=`(chr=as.factor(chr), ref=as.factor(ref), alt=as.factor(alt), genotype=as.factor(genotype))]

  site_windows <- all_calls[, .N, by=.(chr=as.character(chr), pos=as.integer(pos))]
  site_windows <- site_windows[order(chr, pos)]

  fa <- FaFile(params$reference)
  open(fa)
  on.exit(close(fa), add=TRUE)
  chrom_lengths <- seqlengths(fa)

  site_windows[, window_start := pmax(1L, pos - 50L)]
  site_windows[, window_end   := pmin(as.integer(chrom_lengths[chr]), pos + 50L)]

  gr   <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(seqnames=site_windows$chr,
           ranges=IRanges::IRanges(start=site_windows$window_start, end=site_windows$window_end))
  seqs <- scanFa(fa, param=gr)
  base_counts <- alphabetFrequency(seqs, baseOnly=TRUE)[, c("A","C","G","T"), drop=FALSE]

  site_windows[, gc_count    := base_counts[,"G"] + base_counts[,"C"]]
  site_windows[, at_count    := base_counts[,"A"] + base_counts[,"T"]]
  site_windows[, cpg_count   := as.integer(vcountPattern("CG", seqs, fixed=TRUE))]
  site_windows[, window_width := window_end - window_start + 1L]
  rm(seqs)
  site_windows[, chr := factor(chr, levels=levels(all_calls$chr))]
  all_calls[site_windows, on=.(chr, pos), `:=`(
    gc_count=i.gc_count, at_count=i.at_count, cpg_count=i.cpg_count,
    window_start=i.window_start, window_end=i.window_end, window_width=i.window_width
  )]
}
```

GC bias:

```{r gc_bias, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (isTRUE(params$plot_gc)) {
  beta_per_pos <- all_calls[, .(beta=round(mean(beta),1),
                                gc_frac=round(sum(gc_count)/sum(gc_count+at_count), 1),
                                cpgs=round(mean(cpg_count), 1)), by=.(chr, pos)]
  for_plot <- beta_per_pos[, .N, by=.(beta, gc_frac)]
  print(ggplot(for_plot, aes(x=gc_frac, y=beta, fill=N)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low="black", mid="orange", high="purple", midpoint=max(for_plot$N)/2) +
    xlab("%GC in 100bp window") + ylab("Methylation") + theme_classic())
}
```

CpG bias:

```{r cpg_bias, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (isTRUE(params$plot_gc)) {
  for_plot <- beta_per_pos[, .N, by=.(beta, cpgs)]
  print(ggplot(for_plot, aes(x=cpgs, y=beta, fill=N)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low="black", mid="orange", high="purple", midpoint=max(for_plot$N)/2) +
    xlab("CpGs in 100bp window") + ylab("Methylation") + theme_classic())
}
```

Depth bias:

```{r depth_bias, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (isTRUE(params$plot_gc)) {
  depth_by_cpg <- all_calls[, .(depth=round(mean(depth)), cpgs=round(mean(cpg_count))), by=.(chr, pos)]
  for_plot     <- depth_by_cpg[, .N, by=.(cpgs, depth)]
  print(ggplot(for_plot, aes(x=cpgs, y=depth, fill=N)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low="black", mid="orange", high="purple", midpoint=max(for_plot$N)/2) +
    xlab("CpGs in 100bp window") + ylab("Depth") +
    ylim(0, quantile(depth_by_cpg$depth, 0.99)) + theme_classic())
}
```
